An [[Armbrace of Truth]] is a collectible item that can be traded for [[Tormented weapon]]s and obtained in the [[Domain of Anguish]].

==Acquisition==
*From a [[Spirit of Truth]] in exchange for 60 [[Anguish Gemstone]]s (15 of each type).
*From a [[Coffer of Whispers]] as a random reward.

==Collectors==
{{:Deacon of Whispers/Collector}}

==Notes==
* '''Armbrace(s)''', '''arm(s)''' and '''a''' are abbreviated terms for Armbraces of Truth.
* Since a single character can only hold a maximum of 100{{plat}} at any one time, armbraces are used as an alternate [[currency]] to facilitate high-value trades, e.g. for hard-to-obtain [[weapon]]s or [[miniature]]s. Other common alternatives include [[Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm]] and [[Zaishen Key]]s.

==Trivia==
*This item is commonly misspelled as Ambrace.
*In the [[duping]] incident of 2007, players were able to duplicate items by exploiting a [[bug]] in the [[reconnect after disconnect]] function. Although this violated the [[EULA]], some players cloned hundreds of thousands of armbraces in this time. [[ArenaNet]] staff took steps to ban the most egregious offenders, but it is believed that a sizable portion of the armbraces existed in-game for a decade. A cloned armbrace is indistinguishable from a legitimate armbrace, and functions exactly the same.
